tasks.short: Develop methods and procedures, analyse the results, and present the findings.

steps.what: Plan the research methodologies, instrumentation and procedures.
Enter totals after analyzing each of those procedures.
Fill findings lines from the analyzing totals she entered.
Check each findings line matches an analyzing total.
Presenting findings to the scientific audience and the public.

tasks.design: She plans the research methodologies and enters each result total herself. The {SPREADSHEET} fills one findings line per total she entered, and she checks the line. She does the presenting to the scientific audience and the public.
tasks.previous_blocker: The result totals sat in instrument notes, and the findings table was retyped before she could present.
tasks.enabler_now: A sheet can copy a result total she has already entered beside the procedure name.
tasks.still_hard: She still chooses the methodology and still presents it. A blank total does not analyse the run.
tasks.human_edge: She judges whether a result is real enough to present to a scientific audience.
tasks.altitude: The experiment and the presenting are unchanged. She gains a findings sheet only after she has entered the totals.

reach.task: Record instrument readings beside the procedure
reach.learn: Which readings are raw totals she entered, and which are the instrument's own status codes.

evidence.claim: Copying a result total she entered into a findings line does not choose the methodology and does not present the finding. Model knowledge.
Health data are a special category under the GDPR rule on special categories.
Using special-category data for research needs safeguards under the GDPR research rule.
The Dutch implementation law sets further conditions for research with health data without consent.
Software that informs a person about a genetic predisposition can be an in vitro diagnostic device under the EU in vitro diagnostic regulation.

assumptions: s2 produces the procedure name and the result total. s3 copies those two fields into one findings line, or leaves the line blank.
The sheet is not sent, raises no alert, and is not given to a patient as a genetic result.
unknowns: Which instrument export holds the result totals, and who may read them.
Whether this laboratory relies on consent or on the research exception for those totals.
research_questions: How often are the result totals already entered before she presents?

already_counted.description: Reading each findings line against the total she entered is the check in s4.

incremental.description: Drop a findings line when the procedure name in the method note changes.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a week where she has already entered the result totals, only the findings sheet is shorter. The methodologies, the analysis and the presenting stay. If a total is missing, that line stays blank and she writes it.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Teach medical and laboratory procedures to physicians, residents and technicians.

steps.what: Note the principles of medicine and the laboratory procedures.
Fill a teaching sheet with those laboratory procedures.
Check the sheet states only the procedures she noted.
Teach physicians, residents, students and technicians those procedures.

tasks.design: She notes the principles of medicine and the laboratory procedures she will teach. The {DOCS} store fills a sheet from only those steps, and she checks it adds none. She teaches the physicians, residents, students and technicians herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The procedure steps lived in a protocol folder, and each teaching session started by copying them onto a page.
tasks.enabler_now: A sheet can list laboratory procedure steps she has already written.
tasks.still_hard: She still has to teach in the room. A copied step does not answer a resident's question.
tasks.human_edge: She judges what a physician can safely try, and when to stop the demonstration.
tasks.altitude: The teaching hour is unchanged. She gains a procedure sheet only for steps she has already noted.

reach.task: Keep the approved laboratory procedure pages
reach.learn: Which procedure steps are already on the approved page, and which she still explains only in the room.

evidence.claim: Copying a laboratory procedure she noted onto a sheet is not the teaching. Model knowledge.
Health data are a special category under the GDPR rule on special categories.

assumptions: s1 produces the procedure name and the steps in her words. s2 copies those steps and adds no step.
The sheet names no patient and is not sent to the physicians. No alert is raised.
unknowns: Whether a teaching example later names an identifiable patient.
research_questions: How often does the procedure sheet match the steps she teaches that week?

already_counted.description: Reading each procedure line against the steps she noted is the check in s3.

incremental.description: Replace a procedure line when the approved steps change.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a week where she has already noted the procedures, only the procedure sheet is shorter. The teaching stays. A changed procedure leaves the line blank and she teaches from her own note.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Write scientific articles and publish them in journals.

steps.what: Choose which results the scientific articles will claim.
List figures and journals citations the articles will use.
Draft articles that quote only those result figures.

loop.input: The result figures, the claim and the citation identifiers she listed in s2.
loop.output: Article paragraphs that quote only those figures and attach only those identifiers.
loop.check: Each paragraph quotes a result she listed. A paragraph that adds a result, a patient, a method or a citation she did not list fails.
loop.stop: One pass. A failing paragraph is dropped. If every paragraph fails, the draft stays blank and she writes the articles.
loop.why_not_simpler: A field copy cannot say what a result means, or tell her citation from a made-up one.

steps.what: Resolve articles citations against the citation index.
Check articles paragraphs add no result she did not list.
Confirm the articles text before the manuscript is filed.
File the confirmed articles in the manuscript store.
Publish the articles in the scientific journals.

tasks.design: She chooses the claim and lists the result figures and citation identifiers. A draft in {DOCS} writes paragraphs that quote only those figures, and a lookup in the citation index ({OTHER}) marks which identifiers resolve. She confirms the text, a separate write files only that text in the manuscript store ({OTHER}), and she publishes the articles herself.
tasks.previous_blocker: The article was typed from scattered result notes, and each citation was checked by hand against a printout.
tasks.enabler_now: A draft can quote result figures she has listed, and a citation index can say whether an identifier resolves.
tasks.still_hard: She still chooses the claim and still publishes. A failed citation does not invent a source.
tasks.human_edge: She judges what the result means, and whether it is ready for a journal.

ambition.what: She confirms the article text the same week the results and the citation identifiers are in her note.

tasks.altitude: Choosing the claim and publishing stay hers. The draft appears only after the figures and the identifiers are in her note, and she confirms the text before it is filed.

reach.task: Assemble the result figures for a manuscript
reach.learn: Which figures are results she listed, and which still need her claim before they can be drafted.

evidence.claim: Benchling drafts notebook entries and study reports and checks entries.
A published test found that GPT-3.5 fabricated 55 percent and GPT-4 fabricated 18 percent of 636 generated citations.
A citation that does not match an identifier she listed is dropped, and those published fabrication rates are not this laboratory's time saving. Model knowledge.
Health data are a special category under the GDPR rule on special categories.
Using special-category data for research needs safeguards under the GDPR research rule.
European research guidelines advise against generative AI in peer review and in evaluations.
An electronic notebook audit trail of who did what may count as observing performance under the Dutch works-councils act.

assumptions: s2 produces the result figure, the claim in her words, and the citation identifier. s3 writes only from that list. s4 returns a match or a blank and does not edit the paragraph.
s7 files only the text she confirmed in s6. The file step does not send the articles to a journal. The draft is not used to review another group's paper. No audio is stored.
unknowns: Which manuscript store keeps the file, and whether the works council treats its edit log as performance observation.
Whether the article names an identifiable patient.
research_questions: How often does a citation identifier she listed fail to resolve?

already_counted.description: Reading each paragraph against the result she listed is the check in s5.

incremental.description: Keep the rule that drops a citation she did not list, and the blank-draft fallback.

approvals.approved_version: confirmed article text she accepted in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the results and the citation identifiers are already in her note, the draft, the citation match and the file replace typing. Choosing the claim and publishing stay. If a citation does not match, that paragraph is dropped and she writes it. Published citation-error rates are not used as this laboratory's saving.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Set the research aim these grant applications will fund.
Enter methods and budget lines for those research grants.
Fill applications fields from the budget lines she entered.
Draft applications narrative from the research aim she set.

loop.input: The research aim, methods, dates and budget lines she entered in s1 and s2.
loop.output: Narrative paragraphs that state only that aim, those methods and those budget lines, in visible text.
loop.check: Each paragraph quotes an aim, a method or a budget line she entered. A paragraph that adds an aim, a method, a budget figure or a patient outcome she did not enter fails. Hidden text fails.
loop.stop: One pass. A failing paragraph is dropped. If every paragraph fails, the narrative stays blank and she writes the applications.
loop.why_not_simpler: A field copy cannot argue why the work should be funded, or show hidden text.

steps.what: Check applications add no research aim she did not set.
Confirm these applications for the research grants.
File the confirmed applications in the grants folder.
Submit these applications for the research grants.

tasks.design: She sets the research aim and enters the budget lines and methods. The {SPREADSHEET} fills the application fields from those lines, and a draft in {DOCS} writes the narrative in visible text with no hidden line. She confirms it, a separate write files only that text in the grants folder ({OTHER}), and she submits the applications herself on the funder portal ({OTHER}).
tasks.previous_blocker: Budget lines and the narrative were retyped into each funder form, and a hidden instruction could sit in the file unseen.
tasks.enabler_now: A form can copy budget lines she has entered, and a draft can state only the aim she wrote, in visible text.
tasks.still_hard: She still chooses the aim and still submits. The draft does not answer the funder.
tasks.human_edge: She judges which work is worth funding, and what she will promise.

ambition.what: She confirms a short application the same week the aim and the budget lines are in her note.

tasks.altitude: The aim and the submission stay hers. The form and the narrative appear only from fields she entered, and she confirms the text before it is filed.

reach.task: Keep the funder form's required fields
reach.learn: Which grant fields are budget lines she can enter, and which are the aim she must still write.

evidence.claim: NWO bars generative AI for its assessors and bars hidden prompts in grant applications.
European research guidelines advise against generative AI in peer review and in evaluations.
Copying a budget line she entered does not choose the research aim, and no vendor time-saving figure is used as this laboratory's saving. Model knowledge.
Health data are a special category under the GDPR rule on special categories.

assumptions: s1 produces the research aim in her words. s2 produces the budget lines, the dates and the method names. s3 copies those fields. s4 writes only from s1 and s2 and writes no hidden text.
s7 files only the text she confirmed in s6. She submits the applications herself. The draft is not an assessment of someone else's proposal.
unknowns: Which funder form is in use.
Whether the application names an identifiable patient cohort.
research_questions: How often is the budget complete before she starts the narrative?

already_counted.description: Reading the form and the narrative against the aim and the budget she entered is the check in s5.

incremental.description: Keep the rule that drops hidden text and an aim she did not set, and the blank-narrative fallback.

approvals.approved_version: confirmed application text she accepted in s6

time_saved_range_pct.basis: When the aim, the budget and the methods are already in her note, the form, the narrative and the file replace typing. Choosing the aim and submitting stay. A new aim leaves the narrative blank and she writes it. No vendor time-saving figure is used.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: The week is still the experiment, the teaching, the claim of the article and the grant aim. The findings sheet, the procedure sheet, the article draft, the citation match, the manuscript file, the grant form, the grant narrative and the grant file move.
reach: From a biological technician, which instrument readings are raw totals she entered.
skills_to_grow: Spot an article paragraph that adds a result or a citation she did not list.
Keep a grant narrative free of hidden text.
role.ambitious_version: When the results and the citation identifiers are in her note, she confirms the article before she leaves the lab. The experiment, the teaching and the grant aim stay hers.
